text: Brown-Forman is a publicly traded company: its Class A (voting) and Class B (non-voting) common stock trade on the New York Stock Exchange, and it is a "controlled company" under NYSE rules because the Brown family owns more than 50% of its voting stock. Brown-Forman bought the Jack Daniel Distillery in 1956.
short: Brown-Forman (NYSE) is controlled by the Brown family and has owned Jack Daniel's since 1956.

source.name: Brown-Forman – Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended 30 April 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: We are a “controlled company” under New York Stock Exchange rules because the Brown family owns more than 50% of our voting stock.
source.note: Item 5 of the same filing: Class A and Class B common stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbols BFA and BFB.

additionalSources.name: Jack Daniel's Press Room – Background
additionalSources.quote: In 1956, the Jack Daniel Distillery was purchased by Brown-Forman Corporation of Louisville, Ky.
